## Replace the jedi-specific Python resolver with a single generic LSP-client… — 2026-07-29 (parent 7e7903bd90e8)

The jedi-specific Python resolver is replaced by a single generic LSP-based resolver shared across all languages. `JediResolver` and its helpers are deleted entirely. Two new modules are introduced: `LspClient` (minimal synchronous stdio JSON-RPC client implementing `initialize`, `did_open`, `definition`, and `shutdown`) and `LspResolver` + `LspServerSpec` in `lsp_resolver.py`. `specs.py` registers `BASEDPYRIGHT_SPEC`, `PYRIGHT_SPEC`, and `TYPESCRIPT_SPEC` with per-language tree-sitter call-site extractors. `PythonBackend.resolver()` now returns `LspResolver(python_spec())`, and `TypeScriptBackend` gains a matching two-pass `extract_file_data` path. Both degrade to tree-sitter-only when no server is installed or `TRIE_DISABLE_RESOLVER=1`. Tests drop all jedi-specific cases and add `test_python_resolver_recovers_self_method_call`, `test_typescript_resolver_recovers_this_method_call`, `test_resolver_never_raises_on_missing_server`, and `test_lsp_resolver_satisfies_protocol`; `conftest` defaults `TRIE_DISABLE_RESOLVER=1` with an `enable_resolver` fixture to opt individual tests back in.
